reviews.reviewedWording: Riêng câu này của bản chép Toàn Thư, khi Tử Vi cùng Tả Phù và Hữu Bật đồng cung Tài Bạch, sách dùng hình ảnh “財賦之官” — chức việc liên quan tài chính, kho tàng. Đây là cách mô tả truyền thống của cấu hình đang xét; không xác nhận nghề nghiệp, tài sản hoặc kết quả cuộc đời.

sourceComparison.qualification: Text identity and quotation match are established. The proposed direct-host semantic projection is only PARTIAL, not MATCH.

interpretationValidation.grammar: The main verse unambiguously says 紫微輔弼同宮 and associates that co-location with 一呼百諾居上品. Its prose then says 或作三方為次吉，在財帛宮則為財賦之官. A natural broad-topic reading attaches the financial-palace qualification to the combination as a whole, allowing the direct configuration. However the immediately preceding 三方 alternative is also a possible antecedent for the ellipted subject of 在財帛宮. This modern punctuation does not explicitly reset the subject to 同宮, and the stronger general rank of 同宮 does not logically guarantee that every occupational specialization attached to the alternative transfers to it. The requested unambiguous direct-host sufficient-subset reading is therefore not established by this exact sentence.
interpretationValidation.fullTextCorroboration: The later 財宅 section has 紫微輔弼多為財賦之官. This materially corroborates the fiscal-office association and must not be ignored. It still does not explicitly say 同宮 there, and its 多為 is qualified. It is outside the fixed quoted span/context digest. It makes the proposed reading plausible, but does not uniquely resolve the exact single-verse projection or authorize changing its evidence scope without fresh review.
interpretationValidation.pairedAuxiliaries: 輔弼 is the conventional paired abbreviation for 左輔 and 右弼. The full Juan3 text has a 左輔右弼 subsection and uses 左右 for the pair; 同宮 therefore supports all three in one palace for the direct branch. Requiring both is a conservative textual subset; requiring either one instead would not be justified by this candidate.
interpretationValidation.brightnessAndAdverse: The target line states no independent 廟旺, 無殺 or 無刑忌 prerequisite. The surrounding table and separate verses explicitly state such qualifications where applicable; they should not silently be imported as a global predicate or silently discarded from a whole-chart reading. Full Juan3 repeatedly requires synthesis of auspicious/adverse factors. No whole-chart favorable outcome follows from this one verse.
interpretationValidation.pojun: All three positive witnesses contain Phá Quân; witness 2 also contains Kình Dương. 紫微破軍無左右無吉曜 concerns absence of auxiliaries/benefics and cannot be directly applied to positives with both auxiliaries. 紫破命臨於辰戍丑未再加吉曜 is explicitly about 命, not automatically 財帛. 紫微武曲破軍會羊陀 includes additional Wuqu/meeting conditions, and 紫破辰戍 names specific branches, so these are not automatic vetoes either. Their presence demonstrates the danger of promoting this match to a total favorable chart assessment.
interpretationValidation.wording: The exact Vietnamese text appropriately attributes a traditional image, omits rank/wealth promises and disclaims verified life outcomes. 財賦之官 is reasonably rendered as fiscal/revenue office; kho tàng is a contextual paraphrase. Its opening nevertheless asserts precisely the unresolved direct-host attachment as what this sentence says. Attribution and cautious wording cannot repair that scope uncertainty.
interpretationValidation.conditionTree: Exact same_palace(tai_bach,[Tử Vi,Tả Phù,Hữu Bật]) is mechanically satisfied by all three positives and rejected by all seven negatives. Mechanical reachability is not textual validation.
interpretationValidation.resolution: Retain as unresolved research. Do not approve this exact wording or tree, do not alter them under the existing digests, and do not convert a comparator acceptance of matching PARTIAL reports into semantic approval.
